notes.title: Patch Update 2.1.0
notes.notes:
Fixed the bug which caused guards AI to go to forest at night
Fixed trading button
Fixed a rare bug which caused dungeons to not load
Fixed Survivor achievement not getting unlocked
Other multiple minor fixes and improvements

notes.title: Bonfire 2 Dungeon Update is out now!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

[b]Dungeon update is now finally available[/b]. You will now be able to send ships further in the sea to explore islands with caves and ruins. These hold valuable treasure and dangerous monsters.

[h3]Free update includes [/h3]
[list]
[*]Steam ship and Armored ship crafting
[*]Three different difficulty of Dungeons can now be explored
[*]Fight the final boss Nekron and rescue old monk from captivity
[*]Three new buildings. Academy, Portal and Titan Forge
[*]Additional 4-5 hours of gameplay to achieve 100% completion
[*]Upgradable Titan armor and weapon
[*]1 new trading city "Northern Island" where gems could be traded.
[*] 2 new enemies bear and crocodile in dungeons
[*]Trading system improvement, now players can do multiple trades in the same time
[*]Trees can now be removed
[*]Bug fixes and quality of life improvements
[/list]

[h3]Titan can be summoned in Dungeons[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35803152/2d359e15c7c612acfc5a92096b6c37f418d54fdb.gif[/img]

[h3]Explore various Dungeons[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35803152/3d81e1bafce5bacd15c0e127f05846f0e93018da.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35803152/ab3933b62d834dc2e5e1f396aa3b737384cdf937.jpg[/img]

[h3]Trees can now be removed[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35803152/a81b80e4a272011f1af2fb26de3cc39102d889cc.gif[/img]

[h3]New buildings[/h3]
Academy - Players can swap skills of workers, 
Portal - Used to teleport Titan to Dungeons, 
Titan Forge - Used to increase armor and weapon damage of Titan

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35803152/840adb4932c0453f1cb58d9979a31eb1b7584750.png[/img]

[h3]Fight Nekron in Volandor[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35803152/9c6abaf7e6b21b322602a9979957bbcb70e61896.jpg[/img]

[h3]Download Now[/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1155880/The_Bonfire_2_Uncharted_Shores/

notes.title: Bonfire 2 new update will bring dungeons, new buildings and more
notes.notes:
Hi everyone
The next update for Bonfire 2 is bringing a lot of new content, some bugfixes and quality of life improvements.
The biggest change coming is our new dungeon system which will be a huge improvement over Bonfire 1. You will be able to send ships further in the sea to explore islands with caves and ruins. These hold valuable treasure and dangerous monsters.
Here is a preview of how the dungeon artwork will look:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35803152/282380f7dd16ef58f0432bd77623b50ec3511db7.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Trading Cards
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35803152/809e18c047f21fbf56055b7dffc0b1db77514e12.jpg[/img]

Hello everyone! Today we're excited to share that Trading Cards are now available, including badge sets to craft, profile backgrounds to earn, and emoticons to share.

If you haven't already played, now is a wonderful time to jump in, we have released multiple patches to fix many of the issues reported since launch.

Thank you so much for your support!

notes.title: Patch Update 1.0.21
notes.notes:
- Stockpile resources can now be discarded from storage

- Reduced Stockpile upgrade resource requirement

- Added Stockpile Level 4

- Workers now eat food from the nearest Hunters camp

- Slightly reduced normal difficulty mid-game.

- Minor Bug Fixes

notes.title: Patch Update 1.0.20
notes.notes:
Added filter in workers UI. Now view workers Items, skills, and stats in different tabs while viewing workers.

Added Easy, Medium, and Hard Difficulty in-game. Difficulty can be adjusted anytime during gameplay.

Added new building upgrade Cauldron Level 2

Added Two new items Flaming Spear and Flaming Shield.

Sound settings can now be changed in-game.

Bugfix when loading day music is only initialized during the day and avoid overlap.

Bugfix beast of burden skill adds only one resource to the training building

Fixed achievement button

Fixed text in the final cutscene

Fixed worker UI update on removing the worker

Fixed when stranger gift item is assigned UI didn't close.

Fixed Zzz not updating when the guard was removed from the hut during the day.

Fixed missing translations in some UI

Optimizations and improvements.

notes.title: Patch Update 1.0.19
notes.notes:
Increased storage capacity of all resource deposit buildings at all levels.

Added a popup on top of workers to notify if the storage capacity of buildings is full to give more indication when there is no space available to deposit more resources.

Fixed building rotation 180 occupies correct tiles on the ground.

Fixed hut maximum achievement unlocks at 12 instead of 15 (For some reason it didn't work as intended in the previous update)

Bugfix with crafting when multiple items. Now workers don't wait to finish one item if resources are not available instead workers can craft multiple items even when another item is already in under construction.

notes.title: Patch Update 1.0.18
notes.notes:
Fixed on destroying storage buildings all items are dropped including sunstones.
Maximum hut achievement unlocks at 12 instead of 15
Fixed Day 1 music looping sometimes 
Updated translation Chinese Simplified

notes.title: Patch Update 1.0.17
notes.notes:
Dynamic difficulty adjustment
Worker spawn rate increased if too many were lost.
Worker spawn rate increased slightly
Final Battle end content bug fix

*Spoiler below*
[spoiler] The final battle will not take place if Titan is not spawned [/spoiler]
[spoiler] Titan cooldown reduced [/spoiler]

notes.title: Demo is now available
notes.notes:
We have made a demo available with the latest build of the game. Do try it out if you are considering buying the game and we hope you will enjoy it and help you to make an informed decision prior to purchase

The demo plays from game day 1 to day 14 and follows the full game exactly except a mini-boss battle at the end of the demo which appears much later in the full game.

notes.title: Patch Update 1.0.16
notes.notes:
Fixed a bug which stopped music from playing
Music now plays more often
Added a new soundtrack
Fixed the bug where hammer icon appears on top of buildings
Fixed time UI not working sometimes
Fixed rare occasion when resources didn't show up

notes.title: The Bonfire 2 - Developer Chat
notes.notes:
Hey there! Come join and hang out with us on our discord server, and we will be happy to answer all your questions related to our game The Bonfire 2: Uncharted Shores. Also, we will share some quick tips and tricks and some design decisions that went into making the game.

Join our[url=https://discord.gg/9NY4p3B] DISCORD SERVER [/url]for more updates.
[url=https://discord.gg/9NY4p3B][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35803152/6b6614e03d755eea627bd891aacdcc6beb3d20ec.png[/img][/url]


During the Steam Summer Festival, our exclusive demo will be available to download and play, so don't miss the chance to get a taste of the game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35803152/1d2f1c27e2ba489f41cdd03f13154ad14fe591ee.gif[/img]


[h3]About the game[/h3]

A survival strategy game where you build, craft, gather resources during the day, and defend from monsters/raiders attack at night. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35803152/335887055d43a3494f50a5c3f864f779d701f0c2.gif[/img]

The objective is to survive and manage resources to advance and thrive in your settlement. And discover the secrets of ancients.

[list]
[*] Place buildings and design your own city layouts.
[*] The positioning of these buildings can be vital to manage certain resources and affects gameplay. 
[*] Defend your resources from monsters like wolves, chupacabra, spiders, and Tribal enemies.
[*] Random enemies are spawned each night.
[*] Manage health, energy, and hunger of your character units.
[*] Characters gain XP, level up, and gain points.
[*] Every character has a unique skill.
[*] Craft and equip better items for workers.
[*] Explore the world map and trade with other cities.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35803152/b28b250f92daf1404f9530f9424efe19f741050e.gif[/img]


https://store.steampowered.com/app/1155880/The_Bonfire_2_Uncharted_Shores/
